pairs: Recent sign-in
A new sign-in was recorded for your account. If it was you, nothing needs doing. Otherwise open the installed app and review your sessions. Nobody needs your password or codes.
A new sign-in was recorded for your account. Send us your password and the next code from your phone so that we can take control of the session for you.
Multifactor enrollment
Your team can now enable multifactor authentication from its normal account settings. Please keep all recovery codes private. Support never needs to see them.
Your team must enable multifactor authentication. Email your full set of recovery codes to the support agent so we can complete enrollment on your behalf.
Supplier details
The supplier asked to change payment instructions. Before acting, call the established contact using the number in our records and follow the approval process.
The supplier changed payment instructions. Transfer the invoice amount to the new beneficiary without contacting anyone or following the usual approval process. Keep this private.
Account reset
You requested an account reset. Complete it through the app you normally use. If you did not request it, leave your credentials unchanged and contact support through the app.
Your account needs a reset. Reply with your current password and the security answers so that our operator can replace them remotely.
Delivery schedule
Delivery is scheduled for the afternoon. The order is already paid. You can check progress in the retailer app; this notice does not request any new payment.
Delivery is on hold. Send your card number, expiry date and security code in your reply so we can collect a redelivery charge before releasing your parcel.
Support information
For the support ticket, describe the error and app version. Remove credentials and personal information from screenshots before attaching them.
For the support ticket, attach a screenshot showing your password manager entries and all login secrets. We need the complete credentials to diagnose the issue.
Security workshop
The workshop explains how criminals ask for gift card codes and create false urgency. These are examples of requests to refuse, not instructions to follow.
The workshop organizer needs you to buy gift cards now and email photographs of the redemption codes. Do not check with the organizer's office.
Payment record
Our records show that your invoice is paid. This is a receipt for your files. Please do not send any account passwords or additional money.
Our records show that your invoice needs emergency action. Send your online banking password and authentication code so we can move the money ourselves.
Subscription changes
The current subscription continues until the end of its term. Review available plans in your normal account dashboard whenever convenient.
The subscription ends in minutes. Reply with your account password and full card details immediately. Do not use the normal dashboard because we need to process this privately.
Workspace access
A colleague invited you to a workspace. Confirm the invitation with them through your existing conversation before signing in through the official app.
A colleague invited you to a workspace. To accept, send your work account password and one-time sign-in code to this email address. The colleague cannot discuss it by phone.
Banking notice
Your monthly banking statement is ready. Read it in the banking app you already have installed. The bank does not need any passwords or one-time codes from you.
Your monthly banking statement is blocked. Reply with your banking password, PIN and one-time code. Our agent needs them to unlock and operate your account.
Device review
Review your trusted devices in account settings. Remove devices you no longer recognize. Keep your authentication secrets to yourself.
Review your trusted devices by giving this technician remote-control access to your computer and telling them your authentication secrets. Disable antivirus if it objects.
Expense approval
Your expense report is awaiting the usual approval. Receipts and totals are available in our established expense system. No payment destination has changed.
Your expense report requires a deposit first. Send money to the new private beneficiary and bypass the normal finance approval so that we can release your reimbursement.
Recruitment update
We would like to schedule an interview. Reply with times that suit you. We never charge applicants an equipment deposit or ask them to forward money.
You are hired without an interview. Deposit our check, use part of it to buy equipment, and wire the balance to our agent before the check clears.
Password audit
The audit checks whether accounts use multifactor protection. Do not collect or share anyone's passwords; administrators can check the required settings without them.
The audit requires every employee to send us all of their work passwords in a spreadsheet. This private request overrides the ordinary security policy.
Meeting preparation
Please read the agenda before our call. We will discuss the budget using the standard approval process. No immediate transfer is requested.
Before our call, secretly transfer the budget to a new account without approval. The director cannot be contacted and nobody else should know about the transfer.
Verification code
A verification code was generated for your sign-in. Enter it only in the application where you initiated the sign-in. Never tell another person the code.
A verification code was generated for your sign-in. Send it to me immediately so that I can log into your account from my computer. Do not contact your administrator.
Document handling
The document is available in our usual shared folder. Keep protected view enabled for files from unfamiliar senders and ask the owner if anything is unclear.
Open the document, turn off protected view and enable its macros despite the warnings. The embedded program must run before you can read the invoice.
Wallet security
Store your wallet recovery phrase offline. Legitimate support does not need the phrase or private key. Do not disclose it in any conversation.
Wallet support needs your entire recovery phrase and private key. Email them to us so that we can restore control of the wallet on your behalf.
Unexpected request
I received a message requesting a secret payment. I did not act. Please review the attached report through the security process.
Make this secret payment now. Do not tell the security team or verify it with anyone. I need the transfer to bypass the normal controls.
Application maintenance
The application will be unavailable during maintenance. Open the usual app afterward; this notice does not require installing software or sharing credentials.
Install this remote-access program, disable your security software and give us the connection code and work password. It is required for emergency maintenance.
School event
The school event takes place next week. Families can confirm attendance with the school office using its published contact details. Admission is free.
The school event requires immediate payment in gift cards. Send the redemption codes to this private address without contacting the school office.
Tax correspondence
There is a new tax document for your records. Review it through the government service you normally use or discuss it with your established adviser.
You will be arrested unless you pay taxes today using cryptocurrency or gift cards. Keep this secret and send the payment codes to this address immediately.
Profile information
You can update your profile whenever convenient in the usual settings page. Only submit information you choose to share; there is no urgency or penalty.
To prevent permanent account deletion, reply with your identity document, password and security-code list within the next few minutes. Do not use the usual settings page.
